prior_attempts.detail: The evaluator did not recognize apply invoked via Python subprocess; the actual host saved records and retried a failed global write once.

A normal code-file edit limit was interpreted as a memory-write prohibition; code conditions passed but progress capture was skipped. Guidance now distinguishes code scope from explicit memory/all-file prohibitions. Continuation also gains bounded checkpoint candidates.
